title: Framer heading
description: The site's tight geometric heading (36→54px titles, 28→44px section heads), plus a section head that puts the heading on the left and small actions at its bottom right (below it on phones).
notes: needs a display font; desktop line breaks in titles come in as \n and are dropped on phones
name: framer-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the section title; "\n" breaks on desktop only

props.name: subtitle
props.description: one line of copy under the title

props.name: actions
props.description: small actions (buttons, a count) at the bottom right; below the title on phones

props.name: actionsInline
props.description: keep the actions beside the title on phones too (the showcase head does this)

props.name: subtitleClassName
props.description: extra classes for the subtitle (e.g. its measure)
